title: States Hold $70 Billion That Owners Never Claimed
hook: States are holding $70 billion that still belongs to ordinary people.
closing: A free name search could uncover money that has been waiting for you.
question: Have you searched your name?

segments.say: California holds $15 billion in unclaimed property. Forgotten accounts quietly become a massive public vault.
States returned only $4.49 billion in the latest year. Most of the national pile still waits for owners.
About 14.3% of Americans have unclaimed property. Someone in almost every circle may be owed money.
